product.name: BLACKBOX Wolf
product.description: A web platform that analyzes SQL Server 2012–2022 instances, scores health by category, and delivers findings with actionable recommendations and an executive PDF report. It never runs changes: the DBA decides.
features: 0–100 health score by category and overall
Offline mode: the client runs read-only scripts without opening their network
Declarative rule engine based on best practices
Augmentative AI that correlates and prioritizes, with sanitized data
AES-256-GCM encrypted credentials, roles, and audit trail
